name: Lama
summary: A shedding card game where duplicate values count once and going out lets you discard points tokens.
rules_text: Each player gets 6 cards from a 56-card deck (eight each of 1-6 and Llama). One card starts the discard pile. On your turn you must either play, draw, or quit. You may play if your card equals the top discard or is exactly one higher; 6 allows Llama, Llama allows Llama or 1. If you draw, you take one card and cannot play that turn; if the draw pile is empty you cannot draw. If you quit, lay your remaining cards face down and you are out for the round. If all but one quit, the last player continues but may not draw. Round ends when someone empties their hand or all players have quit. You score your remaining cards: each distinct value you hold counts once, number cards at face value, Llama as 10. Take that many points in tokens (1s and 10s). If you emptied your hand, return one token of your choice. Reshuffle for next round. Game ends when someone has 40+ points; fewest points wins.
rating_reason: Card shedding with hidden hands, sequential play, clear strategy
